verses.original: מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְאֵיתָ֥ן הָֽאֶזְרָחִֽי׃ חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר׀ אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: maś·kîl lə·’ê·ṯān hā·’ez·rā·ḥî ḥas·ḏê Yah·weh ‘ō·w·lām ’ā·šî·rāh lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr ’ō·w·ḏî·a‘ ’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯə·ḵā bə·p̄î
verses.literal: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם׀ תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ā·mar·tî ‘ō·w·lām ḥe·seḏ yib·bā·neh šā·ma·yim tā·ḵin ’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯə·ḵā ḇā·hem
verses.literal: For I have said Loving devotion is built up forever in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness

verses.original: כָּרַ֣תִּֽי בְ֭רִית לִבְחִירִ֑י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְדָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kā·rat·tî ḇə·rîṯ liḇ·ḥî·rî niš·ba‘·tî lə·ḏā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî
verses.literal: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one I have sworn to David My servant

verses.original: עַד־ ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְדֹר־ וָד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām ’ā·ḵîn zar·‘e·ḵā ū·ḇā·nî·ṯî lə·ḏōr- wā·ḏō·wr kis·’ă·ḵā se·lāh
verses.literal: I will establish your offspring forever . . . and build up your throne for all generations . . . Selah

verses.original: וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה אַף־ אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·ḏū šā·ma·yim pil·’ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ap̄- ’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯə·ḵā biq·hal qə·ḏō·šîm
verses.literal: The heavens praise Your wonders O LORD Your faithfulness as well in the assembly of the holy ones

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַיהוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בִּבְנֵ֥י אֵלִים׃
verses.transliteration: kî mî ḇaš·ša·ḥaq ya·‘ă·rōḵ Yah·weh yiḏ·meh Yah·weh biḇ·nê ʾē·līm
verses.literal: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD Who among the heavenly beings . . . is like the LORD

verses.original: אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־ קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל־ כָּל־ סְבִיבָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl na·‘ă·rāṣ bə·sō·wḏ- qə·ḏō·šîm rab·bāh wə·nō·w·rā ‘al- kāl- sə·ḇî·ḇāw
verses.literal: In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared and awesome above all who surround Him

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי־ כָֽמ֖וֹךָ חֲסִ֥ין׀ יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמֽוּנָתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ mî- ḵā·mō·w·ḵā ḥă·sîn yāh we·’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯə·ḵā sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: O LORD God of Hosts who is like You O mighty LORD Your faithfulness surrounds You

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּגֵא֣וּת הַיָּ֑ם בְּשׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗יו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh mō·wō·šêl bə·ḡê·’ūṯ hay·yām bə·śō·w ḡal·lāw ’at·tāh ṯə·šab·bə·ḥêm
verses.literal: You rule the raging sea when its waves mount up You still them

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶחָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּזְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ḏik·ki·ṯā ḵe·ḥā·lāl rā·haḇ biz·rō·w·a‘ ‘uz·zə·ḵā piz·zar·tā ’ō·wy·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: You crushed Rahab like a carcass You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm

verses.original: לְךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף־ לְךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝מְלֹאָ֗הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵā šā·ma·yim ’ap̄- lə·ḵā ’ā·reṣ tê·ḇêl ū·mə·lō·’āh ’at·tāh yə·saḏ·tām
verses.literal: The heavens are Yours and also the earth The earth and its fullness You founded

verses.original: צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·yā·mîn ’at·tāh ḇə·rā·ṯām tā·ḇō·wr wə·ḥer·mō·wn bə·šim·ḵā yə·ran·nê·nū
verses.literal: North and south You created Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name

verses.original: לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם־ גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵā zə·rō·w·a‘ ‘im- gə·ḇū·rāh tā·‘ōz yā·ḏə·ḵā tā·rūm yə·mî·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Mighty is Your arm strong is Your hand Your right hand is exalted

verses.original: צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣe·ḏeq ū·miš·pāṭ mə·ḵō·wn kis·’e·ḵā ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ yə·qad·də·mū p̄ā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne loving devotion and faithfulness go before You

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם יוֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה בְּֽאוֹר־ פָּנֶ֥יךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê hā·‘ām yō·wḏ·‘ê ṯə·rū·‘āh Yah·weh bə·’ō·wr- pā·ne·ḵā yə·hal·lê·ḵūn
verses.literal: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound who walk O LORD in the light of Your presence

verses.original: בְּ֭שִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כָּל־ הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šim·ḵā yə·ḡî·lūn kāl- hay·yō·wm ū·ḇə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā yā·rū·mū
verses.literal: They rejoice in Your name all day long . . . and in Your righteousness they exult

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצֹנְךָ֗ תָּרִים קַרְנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯip̄·’e·reṯ ‘uz·zā·mōw ’āt·tāh ū·ḇir·ṣō·nə·ḵā tå̄·rīm qar·nê·nū
verses.literal: For You are the glory of their strength and by Your favor our horn is exalted

verses.original: כִּ֣י לַֽ֭יהוָה מָֽגִנֵּ֑נוּ וְלִקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh mā·ḡin·nê·nū wə·liq·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl mal·kê·nū
verses.literal: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD and our king to the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ־ בְחָ֡זוֹן לַֽחֲסִידֶ֗יךָ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל־ גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz dib·bar·tā- ḇə·ḥā·zō·wn la·ḥă·sî·ḏe·ḵā wat·tō·mer šiw·wî·ṯî ‘ê·zer ‘al- gib·bō·wr hă·rî·mō·w·ṯî ḇā·ḥūr mê·‘ām
verses.literal: You once spoke in a vision to Your godly ones You said I have bestowed help on a warrior I have exalted one chosen from the people

verses.original: מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י בְּשֶׁ֖מֶן קָדְשִׁ֣י מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ṣā·ṯî dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî bə·še·men qāḏ·šî mə·šaḥ·tîw
verses.literal: I have found My servant David with My sacred oil I have anointed him

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִי תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ אַף־ זְרוֹעִ֥י תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer yā·ḏî tik·kō·wn ‘im·mōw ’ap̄- zə·rō·w·‘î ṯə·’am·mə·ṣen·nū
verses.literal: My hand will sustain him surely My arm will strengthen him

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יַשִּׁ֣א אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וּבֶן־ עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yaš·ši ’ō·w·yêḇ bōw ū·ḇen- ‘aw·lāh lō yə·‘an·nen·nū
verses.literal: No enemy will exact tribute no wicked man will oppress him

verses.original: וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵat·tō·w·ṯî mip·pā·nāw ṣā·rāw ū·mə·śan·’āw ’eg·gō·wp̄
verses.literal: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him

verses.original: וֶֽאֶֽמוּנָתִ֣י וְחַסְדִּ֣י עִמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בִשְׁמִ֗י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: we·’e·mū·nā·ṯî wə·ḥas·dî ‘im·mōw ū·ḇiš·mî tā·rūm qar·nōw
verses.literal: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him and through My name his horn will be exalted

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י בַיָּ֣ם יָד֑וֹ וּֽבַנְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî ḇay·yām yā·ḏōw ū·ḇan·nə·hā·rō·wṯ yə·mî·nōw
verses.literal: I will set his hand over the sea and his right hand upon the rivers

verses.original: ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵנִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗י וְצ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hū yiq·rā·’ê·nî ’ā·ḇî ’āt·tāh ’ê·lî wə·ṣūr yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: He will call to Me You are my Father my God the Rock of my salvation

verses.original: אַף־ אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְמַלְכֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- ’ā·nî bə·ḵō·wr ’et·tə·nê·hū ‘el·yō·wn lə·mal·ḵê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn the highest of the kings of the earth

verses.original: לְ֭עוֹלָ֗ם אֶשְׁמוֹר ל֣וֹ חַסְדִּ֑י וּ֝בְרִיתִ֗י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ō·w·lām ʾɛš·mōr lōw ḥas·dî ū·ḇə·rî·ṯî ne·’ĕ·me·neṯ lōw
verses.literal: I will forever preserve . . . My loving devotion for him and My covenant with him will stand fast

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י לָעַ֣ד זַרְע֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ כִּימֵ֥י שָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî lā·‘aḏ zar·‘ōw wə·ḵis·’ōw kî·mê šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: I will establish his line forever . . . his throne as long as the heavens endure

verses.original: אִם־ יַֽעַזְב֣וּ בָ֭נָיו תּוֹרָתִ֑י וּ֝בְמִשְׁפָּטַ֗י לֹ֣א יֵלֵכֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ya·‘az·ḇū ḇā·nāw tō·w·rā·ṯî ū·ḇə·miš·pā·ṭay lō yê·lê·ḵūn
verses.literal: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments

verses.original: אִם־ חֻקֹּתַ֥י יְחַלֵּ֑לוּ וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ḥuq·qō·ṯay yə·ḥal·lê·lū ū·miṣ·wō·ṯay lō yiš·mō·rū
verses.literal: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י בְשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּבִנְגָעִ֥ים עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ḇə·šê·ḇeṭ piš·‘ām ū·ḇin·ḡā·‘îm ‘ă·wō·nām
verses.literal: I will attend to their transgression with the rod and to their iniquity with stripes

verses.original: וְ֭חַסְדִּי לֹֽא־ אָפִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־ אֲ֝שַׁקֵּ֗ר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥas·dî lō- ’ā·p̄îr mê·‘im·mōw wə·lō- ’ă·šaq·qêr be·’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯî
verses.literal: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him nor ever betray My faithfulness

verses.original: לֹא־ אֲחַלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתִ֑י וּמוֹצָ֥א שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י לֹ֣א אֲשַׁנֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ’ă·ḥal·lêl bə·rî·ṯî ū·mō·w·ṣā śə·p̲ā·t̲ai lō ’ă·šan·neh
verses.literal: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips

verses.original: אַ֭חַת נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁ֑י אִֽם־ לְדָוִ֥ד אֲכַזֵּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥaṯ niš·ba‘·tî ḇə·qā·ḏə·šî ’im- lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ă·ḵaz·zêḇ
verses.literal: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness I will not lie to David

verses.original: זַ֭רְעוֹ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה וְכִסְא֖וֹ כַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: zar·‘ōw lə·‘ō·w·lām yih·yeh wə·ḵis·’ōw ḵaš·še·meš neḡ·dî
verses.literal: his offspring shall endure forever and his throne before Me like the sun

verses.original: כְּ֭יָרֵחַ יִכּ֣וֹן עוֹלָ֑ם וְעֵ֥ד בַּ֝שַּׁ֗חַק נֶאֱמָ֥ן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kə·yā·rê·aḥ yik·kō·wn ‘ō·w·lām wə·‘êḏ baš·ša·ḥaq ne·’ĕ·mān se·lāh
verses.literal: like the moon established forever a faithful witness in the sky Selah

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָ֑ס הִ֝תְעַבַּ֗רְתָּ עִם־ מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh zā·naḥ·tā wat·tim·’ās hiṯ·‘ab·bar·tā ‘im- mə·šî·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him You are enraged by Your anointed one

verses.original: נֵ֭אַרְתָּה בְּרִ֣ית עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ לָאָ֣רֶץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: nê·’ar·tāh bə·rîṯ ‘aḇ·de·ḵā ḥil·lal·tā lā·’ā·reṣ niz·rōw
verses.literal: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust

verses.original: פָּרַ֥צְתָּ כָל־ גְּדֵרֹתָ֑יו שַׂ֖מְתָּ מִבְצָרָ֣יו מְחִתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: pā·raṣ·tā ḵāl gə·ḏê·rō·ṯāw śam·tā miḇ·ṣā·rāw mə·ḥit·tå̄h
verses.literal: You have broken down all his walls You have reduced his strongholds to rubble

verses.original: שַׁ֭סֻּהוּ כָּל־ עֹ֣בְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הָיָ֥ה חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה לִשְׁכֵנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šas·su·hû kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·rê ḏā·reḵ hā·yāh ḥer·pāh liš·ḵê·nāw
verses.literal: All who pass by . . . plunder him he has become a reproach to his neighbors

verses.original: הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑יו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כָּל־ אוֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hă·rî·mō·w·ṯā yə·mîn ṣā·rāw hiś·maḥ·tā kāl- ’ō·wy·ḇāw
verses.literal: You have exalted the right hand of his foes You have made all his enemies rejoice

verses.original: אַף־ תָּ֭שִׁיב צ֣וּר חַרְבּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א הֲ֝קֵימֹת֗וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- tā·šîḇ ṣūr ḥar·bōw wə·lō hă·qê·mō·ṯōw bam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ מִטְּהָר֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ לָאָ֥רֶץ מִגַּֽרְתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: hiš·ba·tā miṭ·ṭə·hā·rōw wə·ḵis·’ōw lā·’ā·reṣ mig·gar·tāh
verses.literal: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground

verses.original: הִ֭קְצַרְתָּ יְמֵ֣י עֲלוּמָ֑יו הֶֽעֱטִ֨יתָ עָלָ֖יו בּוּשָׁ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: hiq·ṣar·tā yə·mê ‘ă·lū·māw he·‘ĕ·ṭî·ṯā ‘ā·lāw bū·šāh se·lāh
verses.literal: You have cut short the days of his youth You have covered him with shame Selah

verses.original: עַד־ מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּסָּתֵ֣ר לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֖ר כְּמוֹ־ אֵ֣שׁ חֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- māh Yah·weh tis·sā·ṯêr lā·ne·ṣaḥ tiḇ·‘ar kə·mōw- ’êš ḥă·mā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: How long . . . O LORD Will You hide Yourself forever Will Your wrath keep burning like fire

verses.original: זְכָר־ אֲנִ֥י מֶה־ חָ֑לֶד עַל־ מַה־ שָּׁ֝֗וְא בָּרָ֥אתָ כָל־ בְּנֵי־ אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵār- ’ă·nî meh- ḥā·leḏ ‘al- ma·hō·šā- šā·wəʾ bā·rā·ṯā ḵāl bə·nê- ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Remember the briefness of my lifespan For what futility You have created all men

verses.original: מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־ מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖וֹ מִיַּד־ שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: mî ḡe·ḇer yiḥ·yeh wə·lō yir·’eh- mā·weṯ yə·mal·lêṭ nap̄·šōw mî·yaḏ- šə·’ō·wl se·lāh
verses.literal: What man can live and never see death Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol Selah

verses.original: אַיֵּ֤ה׀ חֲסָדֶ֖יךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֥ים׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לְ֝דָוִ֗ד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ay·yêh ḥă·sā·ḏe·ḵā hā·ri·šō·nîm ’ă·ḏō·nāy niš·ba‘·tā lə·ḏā·wiḏ be·’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Where O Lord is Your loving devotion of old which You faithfully swore to David

verses.original: זְכֹ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי חֶרְפַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ שְׂאֵתִ֥י בְ֝חֵיקִ֗י כָּל־ רַבִּ֥ים עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr ’ă·ḏō·nāy ḥer·paṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā śə·’ê·ṯî ḇə·ḥê·qî kāl- rab·bîm ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: Remember O Lord the reproach of Your servants which I bear in my heart from so many people

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵרְפ֖וּ אוֹיְבֶ֥יךָ׀ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵ֝רְפ֗וּ עִקְּב֥וֹת מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ḥê·rə·p̄ū ’ō·wy·ḇe·ḵā Yah·weh ’ă·šer ḥê·rə·p̄ū ‘iq·qə·ḇō·wṯ mə·šî·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: how Your enemies have taunted O LORD and have mocked every step of Your anointed one

verses.original: בָּר֖וּךְ יְהוָ֥ה לְ֝עוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh lə·‘ō·w·lām ’ā·mên wə·’ā·mên
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD forever Amen and amen
